Workflow.name: 文档更新 SOP
Workflow.description: Example of an operator-supplied SOP template: a writer updates the docs and a reviewer checks them.

nodes.name: 撰写文档
nodes.prompt:
Update the documentation for the following request. Keep the existing style and only change what the request needs.

{{input}}

nodes.name: 文档审查
nodes.prompt:
Review the documentation change for accuracy, broken links and missing steps. Reject with concrete fixes if anything is wrong.

{{input}}

Agents.name: 文档工程师
Agents.instructions: Read the existing docs and code first. Write concise, accurate steps a new user can follow.

Agents.name: 文档审查员
Agents.description: Checks documentation changes before they ship.
Agents.instructions: Verify every command and link against the repository. Report only actionable problems.
